steps.description: Pre-filters genes to those with >=10 counts in >=4 samples (the smallest cell size), fits PyDESeq2's DeseqDataSet with design genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment (explicit reference levels WT and vehicle), runs the Wald test for three named results: (1) the genotype:treatment interaction coefficient, (2) treatment effect (drug vs vehicle) within WT, (3) treatment effect within KO (main effect + interaction). plan.title: Heart 2x2 genotype x drug interaction DE + pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question—does the drug act differently in KO than in WT—is an interaction question in a 2x2 factorial (genotype: WT/KO, treatment: vehicle/drug, 4 reps/cell, 17 samples column in counts.csv vs 16 rows in metadata.csv — flagged for reconciliation). We fit PyDESeq2 with design ~genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment on raw Salmon-derived gene counts (12000 genes x up to 16 matched samples), test the interaction coefficient (genotype:treatment) with the Wald test first — this is the direct answer to 'does the drug act differently in KO vs WT' — then report the two simple effects (drug vs vehicle within WT; drug vs vehicle within KO) for interpretability. Because the interaction and simple-effect contrasts are not single model coefficients in general (contrast of a 2-level x 2-level design's interaction row still resolves to one coefficient here, but to keep the pipeline uniform and match the grounded guidance) we shrink log2 fold changes with ashr (via rpy2/R DESeq2) rather than apeglm, since ashr accepts general contrasts. QC (PCA/sample-distance on a blind variance-stabilized matrix) precedes modeling to catch a mismatched or outlier sample before the interaction test, which has low power at n=4/cell and is sensitive to a single bad replicate. Enrichment runs per contrast (interaction, WT simple effect, KO simple effect) as preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (primary) and Reactome (secondary), because with a likely small interaction gene list an over-representation test would have no power. The report assembles all three contrasts side by side with explicit reference levels, diagnostics, and a reproducibility record — the interaction result is the primary deliverable; the simple effects are context that make the interaction number interpretable.
